title: Amazon API Gateway REST API to Amazon Connect Task
description: Create an API Gateway REST API that integrates with an Amazon Connect Task.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This CDK project demonstrates integration with Amazon Connect by invoking API Gateway endpoints. Many Amazon Connect customers want to invoke ad-hoc tasks for their agents. These contact center agents can then perform subsequent tasks based on the actions listed.
